queue.title: New SVB Review Finds Fed Missed Repeated Warnings
queue.resumo: A new draft report found that Federal Reserve officials failed to adequately respond to repeated warnings about Silicon Valley Bank’s deteriorating financial condition before its 2023 failure. The report by Starling Trust Sciences was commissioned by Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman, who has long pushed for an outside review of SVB’s failure. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: FTSE Russell Flags Energy Risks
queue.resumo: FTSE Russell’s Indrani De says resilient earnings and AI-driven investment continue to support markets, but investors are becoming more selective. She says capital is increasingly balancing growth exposure with investment-grade debt, while rising refining constraints and energy costs remain key risks heading into winter. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Chair, Ending Six-Decade Run
queue.resumo: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. founder Warren Buffett is stepping down as the company’s chairman to be replaced by his son Howard, effectively ending roughly six decades at the helm of the conglomerate. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior P&C Insurance Analyst Matt Palazola discusses the move and Buffett's legacy with the company. (Source: Bloomberg)
